name: RAMMP
description:
RAMMP runs a full marketing diagnostic from inside your 
AI chat. Ask one question — "Why isn't my marketing 
working?" — and get a scored breakdown of your customer 
journey across six trust stages, your top two fixes, and 
the estimated impact of each.

No dashboard. No login. No switching tabs.

Powered by the ADORE Process™ — a patented six-stage 
trust diagnostic framework built on six years of data 
from 900+ businesses. RAMMP identifies exactly where 
trust breaks in your buying journey and tells you what 
to fix first.

Works across brand messaging, website copy, lead 
generation, onboarding, retention, and more. Free to 
install. Free to run your first diagnostic.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RAMMP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RAMMP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.rammp.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RAMMP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RAMMP provides these MCP tools: run_brand_trust_score, get_brand_trust_score_guide, get_brand_trust_score_full_report, get_trust_marketing_overview, get_strategy_helper, get_branding_helper, get_website_helper, get_commitment_helper, get_onboarding_helper, and get_retention_helper.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RAMMP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to RAMMP in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
RAMMP does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
RAMMP is developed by RAMMP. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
